Narmada Project Payment Dispute Resolved Among Four States

A 50-year-old payment dispute concerning the Narmada project has been resolved through a one-time settlement agreement. The pact was signed by the Chief Ministers of Maharashtra, Gujarat, Rajasthan, and Madhya Pradesh in the presence of Union Minister Amit Shah and Union water resources minister CR Patil.
